brief:
Al-Mujahideen movement said that normalization efforts and meetings with Israeli occupation leaders cannot be separated from ongoing crimes against Palestinians, Shehab Wire reported. The movement characterized such encounters as providing political cover for the occupation to overcome international isolation.

The statement linked diplomatic engagement with the Israeli leadership to what the group described as continuous violations against the Palestinian people, positioning normalization initiatives as incompatible with Palestinian national rights and the memory of those killed in the conflict.

title: Palestinian Mujahideen condemns Netanyahu reception as betrayal of martyrs
